feature: CN receiving local Excel upload always lands on the step-2 verify/edit screen: a clean decode (TE confirmation or truck manifest 車單) no longer auto-creates the order(s) — the operator reviews the decoded rows and presses Create themselves. Gate behavior unchanged: ambiguous part keys and invalid-qty rows ride the warning banner (invalid qty still highlighted and dropped on submit), other issues list as the error banner. PDF upload path untouched.
reason: Operators could not see the decoded rows before stock/orders existed; the sheet is the supplier's own document and qty/invoice/part typos are cheaper to catch on the review screen than after creation
remarks: Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-18-receiving-cn-upload-always-verify-design.md. Reverses the 2026-11-17 auto-create-only clean path (spec 2026-11-17); the verify step that replaced it is now mandatory for all decodes. Backend contract unchanged (POST /admin/receiving-cn/excel, same payload).
